entry.prompt: Ring of standing stones: seven tall rough granite monoliths standing in a circle on a low round grassy mound, one pair joined by a flat lintel stone on top, a small cairn of stacked stones at the centre, all fused to the mound. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism. Chunky shapes, hard edges, flat faces. About 4 m wide and 2.6 m tall. Isolated, no ground plate, no characters, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Stones: weathered grey granite (#8E8C85) with pale sunlit tops (#B9B6AC), cool shadows (#62666A) and pale lichen patches (#B7B58A). Mound: muted alpine turf green (#6F7D4E) with a few mauve heather tufts (#76606A). Faint worn carved spirals only, no letters, no text or logos.
